data.body: AC amendment: Clarify run order relative to Task 1a. create-dso-app.sh runs FIRST (installer), writing merge.strategy=direct as the initial default. Onboarding Phase 3 runs AFTER (during /dso:onboarding session). Phase 3 must read the existing merge.strategy from dso-config.conf and present it as the current default in the prompt (not hardcode 'direct'). This makes Phase 3 idempotent: re-running onboarding shows current value, user confirms or changes. Add to AC: verify SKILL.md Step 2b instructs reading the existing value as the prompt default.
